orders.title: Service orders
orders.subtitle: Each order groups the equipment inspected in one round. Search by code, work order, technique, company or analyst.
orders.visitsHint: Equipment visited in this order. Not a head count.
orders.search: Search by order, work order, technique, company or analyst

visit.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or it is outside your scope.
visit.readingsHint: One row per point. On save the system applies the report's standard again (or the equipment's own, if the report picks none) and recalculates the status.
visit.diaryHint: Background, conclusions and recommendations, each line with its date and author.
visit.ungradedHint: No threshold judges this magnitude: the value has no status.

subtitle: Every visit with who performed it and what they wrote. You can only edit your own while they are open.
emptyBody: They will appear once the first round is performed.

visitForm.title: New visit
visitForm.hint: A visit records what was measured on one equipment within an order. Empty readings are created ready to fill in.

orderForm.title: New service order
orderForm.hint: Groups the visits of a round. The code follows the customer's own naming: MPd-AV-N°006-13.
orderForm.locked: Not changed on an existing order: its visits hang off it.
orderForm.standardHint: Which standard grades this order's readings. Changing it regrades the ones already recorded.

operating.title: Operating data
operating.hint: The equipment's conditions during the round. Without them two readings are not comparable.
operating.empty: This service records no operating data
operating.emptyHint: They are configured in Settings → Operating parameters.

providers.title: Companies
providers.subtitle: Who executes the services: 1A-MIG or a contractor. A company with orders is deactivated, not deleted.
